title: Elevate Nepal : Drone Fundamentals
description: Drone ecosystem fundamentals under DEAP with Impact Hub Kathmandu.
fullText: Attended Elevate Nepal: Drone Fundamentals Training under the Drone Ecosystem Acceleration Program (DEAP). Explored drone business applications across surveying/mapping, agriculture, urban development, cinematography, and disaster preparedness. Grateful to Impact Hub Kathmandu for hosting, with support from The World Bank, KWPF, Impact447, and Airlift Technology.
